events.label: Engine start
events.prompt: Motorcycle kick start, starter whirs then the engine catches and revs once, close-mic

events.label: Engine ride
events.trigger: Loops on its own voice from the round start until the round ends.
events.prompt: Onboard recording of a small motorcycle holding one constant cruising speed, steady even engine drone, no revving, no gear changes, no acceleration, continuous and unchanging

events.label: Buyer pays
events.trigger: A buyer pays and the multiplier steps up one notch.
events.prompt: Mechanical counter wheel clicking over one notch, single dry ratchet click, tight and short, no ring, no music

events.label: Whole multiplier
events.trigger: The multiplier crosses a whole number.
events.prompt: Two clean bell notes rising a step, bright and confident, short, dry, no music

events.label: Big buyer
events.trigger: A buyer hands over several bundles: still a step, so it clicks like one.
events.prompt: Mechanical counter wheel clicking over one notch, single dry ratchet click, tight and short, no ring, no music

events.label: Fuel spills
events.trigger: The strap slips and the can lurches: part of the run is lost.
events.prompt: Fuel sloshing and splashing out of a metal jerrycan onto asphalt, wet glug, short

events.label: Cans lost
events.trigger: Both cans fly off the bike and empty across the road.
events.prompt: Metal jerrycan clangs off a bike and bursts open, liquid gushing across asphalt

events.label: Roadside dog
events.trigger: Now and then while the courier rides past the village.
events.prompt: A street dog barking twice at a passing motorbike, mid-sized dog, outdoors at a distance, short, dry

events.label: Background music
events.trigger: Loops in the background while Sound is on.
events.prompt: Calm looping background music bed for a casual mobile fruit-slicing game set in a sunny tropical bazaar: warm steel drums and soft marimba with light hand percussion, breezy and relaxed, mid tempo, no vocals, no build-up, no climax, seamless 30 second loop, consistent from start to end, instrumental only
